<html><head><meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark"></head><body><pre style="word-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap;"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Milos Vasic
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# HelixQA Test Bank: Catalogizer Full QA - Web
# Comprehensive test coverage for all web frontend pages, features, and edge
# cases. Covers login/auth, dashboard, media browser, entity browser/detail,
# collections, playlists, favorites, media player, search, settings, admin,
# AI dashboard, subtitles, conversion tools, UI/UX quality, and edge cases.

version: "1.0"
name: "Catalogizer Full QA - Web"
description: "Comprehensive QA test bank for the Catalogizer React 18/TS/Vite web frontend covering all pages, features, accessibility, security, and edge cases"
metadata:
  author: "vasic-digital"
  app: "Catalogizer"
  version: "2.3.0"

test_cases:
  # ==================== Login & Auth (FQA-WEB-001 to 020) ====================
  - id: FQA-WEB-001
    name: "Login page loads correctly"
    category: functional
    priority: critical
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to login page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/login in the browser"
        expected: "Login page renders with username field, password field, and Sign In button"
      - name: "Verify branding"
        action: "Check for Catalogizer logo and branding elements"
        expected: "Catalogizer logo and application name are visible"
    tags: [auth, login, page-load]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Login page loads with all form elements and branding visible"

  - id: FQA-WEB-002
    name: "Login with valid admin credentials"
    category: functional
    priority: critical
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to login page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/login"
        expected: "Login form is displayed"
      - name: "Enter admin credentials"
        action: "Type 'admin' in username field, 'admin123' in password field"
        expected: "Credentials are entered in the form fields"
      - name: "Submit login form"
        action: "Click Sign In button"
        expected: "Redirect to /dashboard with dashboard content visible"
    tags: [auth, login, happy-path, critical-flow]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Admin user successfully logs in and is redirected to dashboard"

  - id: FQA-WEB-003
    name: "Login with wrong password shows error"
    category: functional
    priority: critical
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to login page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/login"
        expected: "Login form displayed"
      - name: "Enter wrong credentials"
        action: "Type 'admin' in username, 'wrongpassword' in password"
        expected: "Credentials entered"
      - name: "Submit login form"
        action: "Click Sign In button"
        expected: "Error message displayed indicating invalid credentials"
      - name: "Verify still on login page"
        action: "Check current URL and page content"
        expected: "Still on /login page, not redirected"
    tags: [auth, login, error-handling, negative-test]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Error message shown and user remains on login page"

  - id: FQA-WEB-004
    name: "Login with empty username shows validation"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to login page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/login"
        expected: "Login form displayed"
      - name: "Leave username empty"
        action: "Click into password field, type 'admin123', leave username empty"
        expected: "Password entered, username empty"
      - name: "Submit form"
        action: "Click Sign In button"
        expected: "Validation error shown for empty username field"
    tags: [auth, login, validation, form]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Form validation prevents submission with empty username"

  - id: FQA-WEB-005
    name: "Login with empty password shows validation"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to login page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/login"
        expected: "Login form displayed"
      - name: "Enter only username"
        action: "Type 'admin' in username field, leave password empty"
        expected: "Username entered, password empty"
      - name: "Submit form"
        action: "Click Sign In button"
        expected: "Validation error shown for empty password field"
    tags: [auth, login, validation, form]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Form validation prevents submission with empty password"

  - id: FQA-WEB-006
    name: "Login with both fields empty shows validation"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to login page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/login"
        expected: "Login form displayed"
      - name: "Submit empty form"
        action: "Click Sign In button without entering any data"
        expected: "Validation errors shown for both username and password fields"
    tags: [auth, login, validation, form]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Both fields show validation errors when submitted empty"

  - id: FQA-WEB-007
    name: "Logout redirects to login page"
    category: functional
    priority: critical
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Login as admin"
        action: "Login with admin/admin123 credentials"
        expected: "Redirected to dashboard"
      - name: "Click logout"
        action: "Click the logout button in the header or user menu"
        expected: "User is logged out and redirected to /login"
      - name: "Verify redirect"
        action: "Check current URL"
        expected: "URL is /login and login form is displayed"
    tags: [auth, logout, redirect]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "User is logged out and redirected to login page"

  - id: FQA-WEB-008
    name: "Session persistence after page refresh"
    category: functional
    priority: critical
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Login as admin"
        action: "Login with admin/admin123 credentials"
        expected: "Redirected to dashboard"
      - name: "Refresh the page"
        action: "Press F5 or click browser refresh"
        expected: "Page reloads and user remains logged in on dashboard"
      - name: "Verify auth state"
        action: "Check that dashboard content is visible, not login form"
        expected: "Dashboard is displayed, user is still authenticated"
    tags: [auth, session, persistence, jwt]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "User stays logged in after page refresh"

  - id: FQA-WEB-009
    name: "Protected route redirects to login when unauthenticated"
    category: functional
    priority: critical
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Clear session"
        action: "Clear browser localStorage/cookies or open incognito window"
        expected: "No active session"
      - name: "Navigate to protected route"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/dashboard directly"
        expected: "Redirected to /login page"
      - name: "Verify redirect"
        action: "Check that login form is displayed"
        expected: "Login form visible, not dashboard content"
    tags: [auth, protected-route, redirect, security]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Unauthenticated users are redirected to login"

  - id: FQA-WEB-010
    name: "Register page loads correctly"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to register page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/register"
        expected: "Registration form displayed with username, password, confirm password fields"
      - name: "Verify form elements"
        action: "Check all form fields and submit button are present"
        expected: "Username, password, confirm password fields and Register button visible"
    tags: [auth, register, page-load]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Register page loads with all form elements"

  - id: FQA-WEB-011
    name: "Register form password mismatch validation"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to register page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/register"
        expected: "Registration form displayed"
      - name: "Enter mismatched passwords"
        action: "Type 'newuser' in username, 'password1' in password, 'password2' in confirm"
        expected: "Fields populated"
      - name: "Submit form"
        action: "Click Register button"
        expected: "Validation error indicating passwords do not match"
    tags: [auth, register, validation, form]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Password mismatch is caught by form validation"

  - id: FQA-WEB-012
    name: "Register form minimum password length validation"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to register page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/register"
        expected: "Registration form displayed"
      - name: "Enter short password"
        action: "Type 'newuser' in username, 'ab' in password and confirm password"
        expected: "Fields populated"
      - name: "Submit form"
        action: "Click Register button"
        expected: "Validation error indicating password is too short"
    tags: [auth, register, validation, password-strength]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Short passwords are rejected by form validation"

  - id: FQA-WEB-013
    name: "Navigate from login to register page"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Open login page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/login"
        expected: "Login form displayed"
      - name: "Click register link"
        action: "Click the 'Register' or 'Create account' link"
        expected: "Navigated to /register page with registration form"
    tags: [auth, navigation, login, register]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "User can navigate from login to register page"

  - id: FQA-WEB-014
    name: "Navigate from register to login page"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Open register page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/register"
        expected: "Registration form displayed"
      - name: "Click login link"
        action: "Click the 'Sign In' or 'Already have an account' link"
        expected: "Navigated to /login page with login form"
    tags: [auth, navigation, register, login]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "User can navigate from register to login page"

  - id: FQA-WEB-015
    name: "Login with non-existent username"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to login page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/login"
        expected: "Login form displayed"
      - name: "Enter non-existent credentials"
        action: "Type 'nonexistentuser99' in username, 'somepassword' in password"
        expected: "Credentials entered"
      - name: "Submit form"
        action: "Click Sign In button"
        expected: "Error message indicating invalid credentials"
    tags: [auth, login, negative-test, error-handling]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Error shown for non-existent user without leaking user existence"

  - id: FQA-WEB-016
    name: "Splash screen displays on initial load"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Open app fresh"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000 with cleared cache"
        expected: "Splash screen with Catalogizer branding appears briefly"
      - name: "Wait for transition"
        action: "Wait for splash screen animation to complete"
        expected: "Splash screen fades out and login page or dashboard appears"
    tags: [auth, splash, branding, ux]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Splash screen displays and transitions to main content"

  - id: FQA-WEB-017
    name: "Login form password field masks input"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to login page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/login"
        expected: "Login form displayed"
      - name: "Type in password field"
        action: "Click password field and type 'testpassword'"
        expected: "Password characters are masked with dots/bullets"
    tags: [auth, login, security, password-mask]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Password input is masked for security"

  - id: FQA-WEB-018
    name: "Login form submits on Enter key"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to login page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/login"
        expected: "Login form displayed"
      - name: "Enter credentials"
        action: "Type 'admin' in username, 'admin123' in password"
        expected: "Credentials entered"
      - name: "Press Enter"
        action: "Press Enter key while focused on password field"
        expected: "Form submits and user is logged in, redirected to dashboard"
    tags: [auth, login, keyboard, accessibility]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Enter key submits the login form"

  - id: FQA-WEB-019
    name: "Multiple failed logins do not crash the app"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to login page"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/login"
        expected: "Login form displayed"
      - name: "First failed attempt"
        action: "Submit with 'admin' / 'wrong1'"
        expected: "Error message shown"
      - name: "Second failed attempt"
        action: "Submit with 'admin' / 'wrong2'"
        expected: "Error message shown again"
      - name: "Third failed attempt"
        action: "Submit with 'admin' / 'wrong3'"
        expected: "Error message shown, app still responsive"
      - name: "Successful attempt"
        action: "Submit with 'admin' / 'admin123'"
        expected: "Login succeeds and user is redirected to dashboard"
    tags: [auth, login, resilience, rate-limiting]
    estimated_duration: "30s"
    expected_result: "App handles multiple failed logins gracefully and still allows successful login"

  - id: FQA-WEB-020
    name: "WebSocket connection status indicator"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Login as admin"
        action: "Login with admin/admin123"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Check connection status"
        action: "Look for WebSocket connection status indicator in the UI"
        expected: "Connection status indicator shows connected state"
    tags: [auth, websocket, connection-status, realtime]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "WebSocket connection status is visible and shows connected"

  # ==================== Dashboard (FQA-WEB-021 to 040) ====================
  - id: FQA-WEB-021
    name: "Dashboard loads after login"
    category: functional
    priority: critical
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Login as admin"
        action: "Login with admin/admin123 credentials"
        expected: "Redirected to /dashboard"
      - name: "Verify dashboard content"
        action: "Check that dashboard page is rendered with heading and widgets"
        expected: "Dashboard heading and content area visible"
    tags: [dashboard, page-load, happy-path]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Dashboard page loads successfully after login"

  - id: FQA-WEB-022
    name: "Dashboard shows media statistics"
    category: functional
    priority: critical
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Verify statistics cards"
        action: "Check for DashboardStats component with media count, file count, storage used"
        expected: "Statistics cards are visible with numeric values"
    tags: [dashboard, statistics, stats-cards]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Dashboard displays media statistics with real data"

  - id: FQA-WEB-023
    name: "Dashboard shows recent activity feed"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Verify activity feed"
        action: "Check for ActivityFeed component showing recent events"
        expected: "Activity feed section visible with recent actions or empty state"
    tags: [dashboard, activity-feed, recent-activity]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Recent activity feed renders on dashboard"

  - id: FQA-WEB-024
    name: "Dashboard shows media distribution chart"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Verify chart"
        action: "Check for MediaDistributionChart showing media types breakdown"
        expected: "Chart rendered with media type distribution data"
    tags: [dashboard, chart, media-distribution, recharts]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Media distribution chart renders with correct data"

  - id: FQA-WEB-025
    name: "Dashboard quick access cards work"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Click quick access card"
        action: "Click on a quick access card (e.g., 'Browse Media' or 'Collections')"
        expected: "Navigated to the corresponding page"
    tags: [dashboard, quick-access, navigation]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Quick access cards navigate to correct pages"

  - id: FQA-WEB-026
    name: "Navigation sidebar menu is complete"
    category: functional
    priority: critical
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Login and view sidebar"
        action: "Login as admin and check sidebar navigation menu"
        expected: "Sidebar visible with navigation links"
      - name: "Verify all menu items"
        action: "Check for Dashboard, Media, Browse, Collections, Favorites, Playlists, Analytics, Subtitles, Conversion, AI, Settings, Admin links"
        expected: "All navigation menu items are present and labeled correctly"
    tags: [navigation, sidebar, menu, layout]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "All navigation menu items are present in sidebar"

  - id: FQA-WEB-027
    name: "Sidebar navigation to each page works"
    category: functional
    priority: critical
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Login as admin"
        action: "Login with admin/admin123"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Click Media in sidebar"
        action: "Click 'Media' link in sidebar"
        expected: "Navigated to /media page"
      - name: "Click Browse in sidebar"
        action: "Click 'Browse' link in sidebar"
        expected: "Navigated to /browse page"
      - name: "Click Collections in sidebar"
        action: "Click 'Collections' link in sidebar"
        expected: "Navigated to /collections page"
    tags: [navigation, sidebar, routing]
    estimated_duration: "30s"
    expected_result: "All sidebar navigation links route to correct pages"

  - id: FQA-WEB-028
    name: "Header displays user info after login"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Login as admin"
        action: "Login with admin/admin123"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Check header"
        action: "Look at the header/top bar for user information"
        expected: "Username or avatar is displayed in the header area"
    tags: [layout, header, user-info]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Header shows logged-in user information"

  - id: FQA-WEB-029
    name: "Dashboard widgets render without errors"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Verify no error states"
        action: "Check that no error boundary fallbacks or error messages are displayed"
        expected: "All dashboard widgets render their content or loading states"
    tags: [dashboard, error-boundary, rendering]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "All dashboard widgets render without errors"

  - id: FQA-WEB-030
    name: "Dashboard data refreshes"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed with data"
      - name: "Wait for refresh interval"
        action: "Wait 30-60 seconds for React Query to refetch"
        expected: "Data updates without page reload via background refresh"
    tags: [dashboard, data-refresh, react-query]
    estimated_duration: "60s"
    expected_result: "Dashboard data refreshes automatically in the background"

  - id: FQA-WEB-031
    name: "Root URL redirects to dashboard"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Login as admin"
        action: "Login with admin/admin123"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Navigate to root"
        action: "Open http://localhost:3000/"
        expected: "Automatically redirected to /dashboard"
    tags: [routing, redirect, dashboard]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Root URL redirects authenticated users to /dashboard"

  - id: FQA-WEB-032
    name: "Dashboard loading states visible"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard, observe initial load"
        expected: "Loading skeleton or spinner appears briefly while data loads"
      - name: "Verify transition"
        action: "Wait for data to load"
        expected: "Loading state transitions to rendered content"
    tags: [dashboard, loading-state, ux, skeleton]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Loading states are visible during data fetch"

  - id: FQA-WEB-033
    name: "Dashboard handles API errors gracefully"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard with degraded API"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard (some API endpoints may return errors)"
        expected: "Dashboard renders with error states for failed widgets, not a blank page"
      - name: "Verify page stability"
        action: "Check that the PageErrorBoundary catches errors"
        expected: "Error boundary shows fallback UI instead of crashing the whole page"
    tags: [dashboard, error-handling, error-boundary, resilience]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Dashboard handles API errors with error boundary fallbacks"

  - id: FQA-WEB-034
    name: "Dashboard page title is set correctly"
    category: functional
    priority: low
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard"
        expected: "Browser tab shows correct page title"
    tags: [dashboard, page-title, seo]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Browser tab shows Catalogizer dashboard title"

  - id: FQA-WEB-035
    name: "Dashboard responsive layout on narrow viewport"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Resize to mobile width"
        action: "Resize browser window to 375px width"
        expected: "Dashboard layout adapts: cards stack vertically, sidebar collapses"
    tags: [dashboard, responsive, mobile, layout]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Dashboard adapts to narrow viewport with responsive layout"

  - id: FQA-WEB-036
    name: "Dashboard responsive layout on tablet viewport"
    category: functional
    priority: medium
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Resize to tablet width"
        action: "Resize browser window to 768px width"
        expected: "Dashboard layout adapts: 2-column grid for cards"
    tags: [dashboard, responsive, tablet, layout]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Dashboard adapts to tablet viewport correctly"

  - id: FQA-WEB-037
    name: "Dashboard animation transitions"
    category: functional
    priority: low
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard"
        expected: "Dashboard elements animate in via framer-motion"
      - name: "Verify animations"
        action: "Observe card entrance animations"
        expected: "Cards and widgets have smooth fade/slide-in animations"
    tags: [dashboard, animation, framer-motion, ux]
    estimated_duration: "15s"
    expected_result: "Dashboard elements have smooth entrance animations"

  - id: FQA-WEB-038
    name: "Dashboard stats card shows total files"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Check total files stat"
        action: "Find the stat card showing total files count"
        expected: "Total files count is displayed as a number"
    tags: [dashboard, statistics, total-files]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Total files count is displayed on dashboard"

  - id: FQA-WEB-039
    name: "Dashboard stats card shows storage used"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Check storage stat"
        action: "Find the stat card showing storage usage"
        expected: "Storage used is displayed in human-readable format (GB/TB)"
    tags: [dashboard, statistics, storage]
    estimated_duration: "10s"
    expected_result: "Storage usage is displayed on dashboard in readable format"

  - id: FQA-WEB-040
    name: "Dashboard stats card shows entity count"
    category: functional
    priority: high
    platforms: [web]
    steps:
      - name: "Navigate to dashboard"
        action: "Login and navigate to /dashboard"
        expected: "Dashboard displayed"
      - name: "Check entity count"
        action: "Find the stat card showing total media entities"
        expected: "Entity count displayed as a number"
    tags: [dashboard, statistics, entity-count]
